purpose: Carry result-landing contracts for operations that are automatically fired by reactions.yaml while preserving reactions.yaml as the trigger/predicate authority and system/lib/launchable_operations.py as the command allowlist authority.
migration_rule: Keep only reaction-owned landing metadata here. Inline into a future reaction-aware contract surface or the launch catalog when the owner surface is clean; do not use this file as a central dumping ground for meta-mission or dispatch-policy contracts.

residual_routing.primary: generation-scoped source-progress receipt plus the Python compliance coverage/campaign surfaces
residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Omit deleted documentation-tree rows with typed source_validity evidence; rebuild codex/hologram/system/symbols.json before reconsidering them. Preserve nonzero execution as a reaction/operation residual instead of refiring the same generation.

result_landing_contract.produces: One bounded idempotent preview, approval-gate, or approved apply step for the currently observed Python compliance generation.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: The operation returns zero and the synchronous source-progress evaluator records predicate_clear, progressed, or source_superseded for the admitted signal generation.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: The operation returns nonzero, source progress is unavailable, or the same signal generation makes no progress; replay stays suppressed until the observed generation changes.

outcome_health_contract.semantic_success_requires: a truthful generation-scoped source-progress receipt; process exit alone is not semantic success

residual_routing.primary: reactions ledger entry plus work-ledger projection result
residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Task Ledger note/capture under cap_quick_launchable_operations_landing_surface_contract when project --check --all remains stale or work_ledger.py exits nonzero. Session lifecycle and append obligations remain owned by Work Ledger reconcile/sweep/finalize lanes and must not refire this projection operation.

result_landing_contract.produces: Fresh deterministic work-ledger projection indexes for all family/phase buckets from append-only work_ledger.jsonl substrate.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: work_ledger.py project --all returns ok=true and project --check --all reports fresh projection rows.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: work_ledger.py exits nonzero, project result ok=false, or a projection row remains stale or missing. Stale session pressure is a distinct owner-visible lifecycle residual, not projection failure.

outcome_health_contract.semantic_success_requires: projection freshness only; this operation never claims to settle session lifecycle or missing-append obligations

residual_routing.primary: candidate campaign packet plus reaction_fired/reaction_completed ledger rows
residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Task Ledger note/capture under cap_quick_launchable_operations_landing_surface_contract when the reaction returns nonzero, emits no campaign_packet, or the standard-skill gap remains high after the candidate packet is reviewed
residual_routing.promotion_boundary: controller/apply lane reviews campaign_packet.json before skill authoring, skill_registry mutation, or source edits

result_landing_contract.produces: A deterministic, controller-gated standard-skill pairing campaign packet in draft state.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: reaction returncode is 0; stdout contains wrote_packet; reaction ledger records promotion_state=draft and mutation_policy=candidate_packet_only.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: reaction returncode is nonzero, stdout lacks wrote_packet, campaign packet is missing, or the produced draft remains unreviewed while the standard-skill gap signal stays high.

residual_routing.primary: candidate campaign packet plus reaction_fired/reaction_completed ledger rows
residual_routing.stale_or_failed: Task Ledger note/capture under cap_quick_launchable_operations_landing_surface_contract when the reaction returns nonzero, emits no campaign_packet, or compliance coverage remains low after the candidate packet is reviewed
residual_routing.promotion_boundary: controller/apply lane reviews campaign_packet.json before compliance repairs, standard mutation, or source edits

result_landing_contract.produces: A deterministic, controller-gated compliance autocure campaign packet in draft state.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: reaction returncode is 0; stdout contains wrote_packet; reaction ledger records promotion_state=draft and mutation_policy=candidate_packet_only.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: reaction returncode is nonzero, stdout lacks wrote_packet, campaign packet is missing, or the produced draft remains unreviewed while the compliance coverage signal stays low.
